【原视频简介】
Is Minecraft Dungeons 2 already in trouble? In this Minecraft Dungeons II breakdown, I analyze the new gameplay shown during the Xbox Gamescom presentation, explore the brand-new dimension known as The Sift, and compare its armor, artifacts, talismans, enchantments, and open-world systems with the original game. We’ll also examine the failed boss fight, uncover the game’s story, and explain how to get the new Minecraft Dungeons capes in Java Edition.
